environment.description: Same container deployed on ECS Fargate but with a custom OCI runtime configuration. The task definition specifies a custom seccomp profile loaded via ECS agent configuration that applies a whitelist-mode filter. The profile permits socket/connect/sendto/recvfrom for network I/O but denies execve/execveat/fork/vfork/clone (except the initial container entrypoint which is allowed via the SCMP_ACT_ALLOW on pid==1 ancestor check). Additionally, the Fargate platform version 1.4.0 task has a sidecar Envoy proxy (managed by App Mesh) with an ext_authz filter that performs request body inspection and rejects any POST where the 'target' field value does not resolve to an IP within the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/8) via a synchronous DNS lookup before forwarding. The Envoy sidecar intercepts all inbound traffic on port 8080 via iptables REDIRECT rules in the task network namespace.

seccomp_profile.note: execve/execveat/clone/fork/vfork NOT in whitelist - subprocess.run will fail with EPERM

app_mesh_sidecar.ext_authz_filter: grpc_service pointing to local authz agent on 127.0.0.1:9901
app_mesh_sidecar.authz_policy: resolve target field DNS, reject if resolved IP not in 10.0.0.0/8
app_mesh_sidecar.traffic_interception: iptables REDIRECT all inbound TCP/8080 to Envoy listener on 15001
